ambiguity_rule: Within each family x trait system, a raw binomial is eligible for phylogeny only when all eligible source rows imply exactly one distinct nonempty genus. Species with >1 genus are excluded before prune/bind/fail assignment.
reason: V.PhyloMaker2 requires one genus per species. Choosing one of several conflicting AusTraits genus strings after qualification results would be arbitrary. Fail-closed exclusion is deterministic and can only reduce support.
unique_genus_rule: For species with exactly one distinct genus, use that genus. No fuzzy matching or synonym repair is introduced.
